name: MacAltHub
description: Find verified alternatives to paid macOS utility apps, compare options, and inspect source and license signals.

tools.name: search_alternatives
tools.reason: Searches the read-only MacAltHub catalog for alternatives to paid Mac apps.

tools.name: get_app_detail
tools.reason: Returns license, price, trust signals, and official source metadata for a selected app.

tools.name: compare_apps
tools.reason: Compares two to four alternatives side by side.

data_handling: Read-only catalog metadata. No user accounts, no mutations, no installer execution.
